```{r}
arrival <- read_excel("../data/340101.xlsx", sheet = 2)

arrival_cl <- arrival[-c(1:9), -13] |>
  mutate(...1 = format(as.Date(as.numeric(...1), origin = "1899-12-30"), "%Y-%m"))
```
